response.original_title: {{12ways to guide}} How do I add a passenger to my Silversea Cruise?
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing Silversea Cruise, you must call Silversea directly at +1-888-512-8367 (US/Canada) or contact your travel agent. To add someone to an existing room on a Silversea Cruise, you must call Silversea customer service directly +1-888-512-8367 (US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK), or contact your travel agent, as this cannot be done online or through the mobile app. Reach out to Silversea Cruises at +1-888-512-8367 (US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK), or call your original booking agent. To add someone to a room on a Silversea Cruise, you must call Silversea Cruise Customer Service directly at +1-888-512-8367 (US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK), or contact your original travel advisor. You cannot add a passenger online or through the mobile app. Your stateroom must physically support an extra person via a sofa bed, third berth, or Pullman setup. If your room is at maximum capacity, you may need to upgrade to a larger room.
